decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits squarely within the firm's core upholstery knowledge and has its own web page, so the firm can read its results reliably and keep refining it through in-house development.

Flame-retardant jacquard curtains build on the firm's functional-fabric expertise for hospitality and contract projects, a segment where its accumulated knowledge lets it improve the product and sustain demand.

The double-face wool-blend extends existing capabilities, but its low visibility and a blend composition at odds with the move away from hard-to-recycle mixes make its future less certain, though not yet enough to drop it.

The wool bouclé leno draws on the firm's sheer-fabric and wool know-how and supports the renewable-materials direction, so the firm can absorb market feedback and refine it rather than withdraw it, unlike the similar Product B.
The newly launched braided-structure fabric has its own web page and builds on established weaving and upholstery knowledge, so it deserves time for the firm to learn from early results.
